apps.name: Echo
apps.localizedDescription:
Echo — First Release
Your music. Your podcasts. Your listening experience.
Meet Echo, a native music and podcast player for iPhone and iPad. Bring your personal music collection, playlists, podcasts, and audio discovery together in one customizable app.
The first release introduces offline listening, smart playlists, advanced audio controls, Spotify playlist transfer, interactive widgets, and Echo Intelligence, an optional experimental assistant.
Your Music, Organized Your Way
Build a personal library from imported audio files and enjoy your collection offline.
- Browse your music by song, album, or artist.
- Edit track information and album artwork.
- Save favorite songs and favorite albums independently.
- Return to recently played tracks and explore newly added music.
- Use listening history and library-based recommendations to rediscover your collection.
Playlists That Work for You
Create personal playlists with built-in covers or custom artwork, including image cropping and positioning.
For collections that evolve automatically, use Smart Playlists. Choose a preset or build rules around genre, release year, favorites, and listening activity, with configurable filters and sorting.
A Home Screen Built Around You
Make Home reflect how you listen. Add, remove, and reorder sections to keep your most-used collections within reach.
Explore:
- Quick Picks and personalized recommendations.
- Recently played and recently added music.
- Favorite artists, songs, and albums.
- Hidden gems and albums worth revisiting.
- Listening activity and podcast recommendations.
- Echo Flow, a continuous listening session drawn from your library.
The Home Now Playing card includes an audio-reactive visualization that responds to local music playback.
More Control Over Your Sound
Move between the mini-player and full-screen player, manage a shared music and podcast queue, and keep listening in the background.
- Add tracks to play next and reorder the queue.
- Use shuffle and repeat.
- Control playback from the Lock Screen and Control Center.
- Send audio to compatible devices using AirPlay.
Equalizer and Audio Output
Shape local music playback with a six-band equalizer, built-in presets, and custom adjustments. Choose stereo or mono output to suit your preferences.
Choose How Tracks Connect
Playback mode	Experience
Direct	Standard track-to-track playback.
Gapless	Continuous playback between tracks.
Crossfade	Adjustable overlap from 1 to 12 seconds.
Mix	Automatic transitions that attempt beat alignment for suitable tracks, with an energy-based crossfade when reliable alignment is unavailable.


Preview transitions using built-in examples or songs from your own library.
Podcasts, Online and Offline
Discover podcasts through Apple’s podcast catalog and explore episodes from publishers’ public RSS feeds.
- Save shows and individual episodes.
- Download episodes for offline listening.
- Resume unfinished episodes from your saved position.
- Adjust playback speed.
- Rewind 15 seconds or skip forward 30 seconds.
- Queue episodes alongside music.
- Read publisher-provided transcripts when available in a supported format.
- Follow shows and optionally receive notifications for newly detected episodes.
Podcast playback uses Echo’s shared player, including AirPlay and Lock Screen controls.
Discover Music and Bring It Into Echo
Spotify Playlist Transfer
Connect Spotify to browse your library and transfer playlists into Echo.
Echo reuses matching songs already in your local collection and can queue missing tracks through Fetch while preserving their playlist positions.
Spotify supplies catalog and playlist information. Audio retrieval depends on the configured Fetch sources.
Fetch: Search, Download, and Import
Bring audio discovery and downloads into one workflow.
- Search supported catalogs for songs, artists, and albums.
- Explore Spotify and YouTube Music catalog results.
- Open supported links and direct MP3 sources.
- Use supported YouTube sources and configurable download providers.
- Select output bitrates of 128, 192, or 320 kbps.
- Process metadata and artwork where available.
- Use Find missing songs to compare a local album with an online edition and select missing tracks for download.
Source availability and download results depend on the selected provider and its configuration.
Lyrics That Follow the Music
View synchronized lyrics when available, follow the current line during playback, and tap a timed line to jump to that moment in the song.
When timing information is unavailable, Echo can display plain lyrics instead.
Lyrics availability depends on provider access and track matching.
Make Echo Your Own
Personalize both the appearance and navigation of the app.
- Choose system, light, dark, or custom appearance.
- Create solid-color or gradient backgrounds.
- Select from ten accent presets or choose a custom accent color.
- Preview appearance changes.
- Customize Home sections, navigation tabs, and your starting tab.
Echo’s main interface supports English, Dutch, French, and German.
Playback Within Reach
Interactive Widgets
Choose from four player widget layouts and a Quick Picks widget.
Supported layouts offer playback controls and favorite actions, while Quick Picks provides direct access to recommended songs. A Lock Screen launcher lets you open Echo quickly.
Siri and Shortcuts
Access supported playback and library actions through Siri and Apple Shortcuts.
Echo Intelligence
Optional. Experimental. Disabled by default.
Enable Echo Intelligence in Settings → Experimental to access an assistant with text input, voice interaction, and an animated visual interface.
Supported actions include:
- Finding music in your local library.
- Controlling playback and managing the queue.
- Creating and managing playlists.
- Working with saved podcasts.
- Adjusting selected app and audio settings.
You Choose Its Access
Permission mode	Behavior
Chat Only	Conversations and read-only queries.
Ask Before Actions	Confirmation before changes are made.
Full App Control	Direct execution of supported actions.


Playlist deletion always requires confirmation.
Provider options include Apple’s on-device models, a downloadable local Qwen model, and configurable cloud services. Capabilities vary by provider. Local Qwen supports conversation, with a separate command path for common music controls.
Experimental Intelligence features currently support English and Dutch, with English fallback for other app languages.
Compatibility and Availability
Requires iOS or iPadOS 26.0 or later.
- Offline listening: Available for imported music and downloaded podcast episodes.
- Online features: Discovery, downloads, lyrics, Spotify account features, and cloud AI require internet access and may need authentication, API keys, or provider configuration.
- Podcasts: Availability depends on public publisher feeds. Apple subscriber-only audio is excluded, and notification timing depends on iOS background scheduling.
- Widgets: Require installation with the widget extension and correctly configured shared access.
- On-device AI: Requires compatible hardware and model availability.
- Cloud AI: Requires explicit permission before requests can leave the device.
Feedback and Support
Report bugs or suggest features through [Echo’s GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Seperatebugle21/Echo/issues).
For bug reports, include your device model, iOS version, Echo build, and steps to reproduce the issue.
